summary: Interleaves reasoning traces with tool actions so agents can plan and act in a loop. Establishes the reason-act-observe cycle that most tool-using agents still use. Grounds reasoning in external observations.
title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
why: Foundational reason-act-observe loop underlying agent harnesses.
